desc: Derive the optimal potential formula: ans = sum_i [T(i-1) - T(L_i)], where L_i is the previous-smaller count, justified by the leftmost-descent greedy argument.
Implement the Fenwick-tree aggregation in Python with O(N log N) time, efficient input, and integer-safe output.
Validate samples, sorted/reverse edge cases, and brute force all permutations for small N (e.g., N<=7) against the formula.
